FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Towers are counted and compared in one look. Ask "how do you know it’s the tallest?" — counting the blocks aloud is the proof.

Prefer paper? The Giraffe’s Tallest Tower worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
